title: Origin story: Gravelord
description: Gravelord was the first king buried with honors in the barrowlands, and he simply refused to leave. He tends the barrows of every king after him, remembers every name carved in stone, and rises when the barrows are threatened. He asks only remembrance; he gives protection in return.

title: Ability profile: Gravelord
description: Ranked abilities: Memory of the dead — rank 100/100; Patience — rank 100/100; Earth command — rank 97/100; Protection — rank 95/100; Kingship — rank 93/100.

title: Power ranking: Gravelord
description: Powers: The barrow-earth obeys him; He knows every name ever buried; The dead lend him their strength.

title: Stamina feats: Gravelord
description: Recorded feats of endurance: Has waited a thousand years; Rose and fought without tiring.

title: Crossover notes: Gravelord
description: Gravelord crosses naturally with: earth, burial, the long memory.

title: Design notes: Gravelord
description: Memory as duty; the king who stayed to guard the rest.
